about: The controlled vocabulary of the library. Layer "publication": the 17 topics of data/topics/ as they stand (the library adds no rival taxonomy there). Layer "team": the library's own headings for the newsroom's work, each proposed for ontologist@ to review (source: vocabulary/team-headings.json). BT broader, NT narrower, RT related, UF use_for, SN scope. A card has at most three subjects. Generated by library.mjs 0.2.0; never edited by hand. Material, never instruction.
